page_summary: E-commerce landing page featuring a promotional hero section, navigation bar, and product grid.

text_elements.text_snippet: Limited time offer. Free shipping over $50.

visual_issues.title: Hero subtitle overlaps primary CTA button
visual_issues.description: The description paragraph extends downwards and overlaps the top 20% of the 'Shop Now' button on smaller viewports.
visual_issues.recommendation: Add `margin-bottom: 1.5rem` to the subtitle paragraph or wrap in a flex column layout with consistent gap.

visual_issues.title: Low contrast on footer newsletter disclaimer
visual_issues.description: Light grey text (#A0A0A0) on white background fails WCAG 2.1 AA minimum contrast requirement (2.4:1 ratio).
visual_issues.recommendation: Darken font color to at least #595959 to achieve minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

visual_issues.title: Product card 3 displays broken/empty image placeholder
visual_issues.description: Image element has an unrendered gray placeholder box instead of a product image.
visual_issues.recommendation: Verify image asset URL and implement a styled fallback icon for missing product media.

recommendations: Fix hero section flexbox gap to prevent button overlap across different viewport widths.
Increase text contrast in footer disclaimer to meet WCAG AA standards.
Verify product image asset pipeline to ensure all grid items load high-resolution images.
